doc:
The record that makes 'once' possible lives in runtime/place-held.json and is saved with `let _ =`. If the
        folder cannot be written (read-only, full, permissions), every relaunch finds no record and says the full line
        again — the 1411 lines back, plus a write failing silently: qal-j09's shape one layer down. Probe: runtime/ made
        read-only after the holder starts, eight relaunches.

breaks.detail: with no record and runtime/ read-only, the full line went to stderr 6 of 6 relaunches: the record's save fails silently and 'once' becomes 'every time' — the 1411 lines, one layer down
breaks.where: arbos-kernel serve.rs HeldRecord::save — `let _ =`; when the record cannot be kept, say so once and fall back to the short line

breaks.detail: with a six-minute-old record that cannot be updated, the error-level escalation went out 6 of 6 relaunches (it is meant to repeat every ten minutes at most): `escalated` is never saved
breaks.where: arbos-kernel serve.rs HeldRecord::save — a save that fails must not be treated as done
